subject: SignalPath pricing structure & commit bridge
messages:
From: Kate Daniels <kate@signalpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: commercial@signalpath.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SignalPath evaluation — need pricing for heavy-embed use

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and latency look great. We are trying to map out expected spend for our Q3 pilot. A few constraints on our side:

- Primary usage will be embeddings (similarity search + recall) — ~75% of tokens. Chat will be lighter (system+user ~25%).
- Monthly token expectation (initial): ~180M tokens/month, with potential to double in 3–6 months if pilot goes well.
- We want a price/commit structure that lets us start with a 3–6 month ramp and then move into a 12–18 month committed band if adoption looks good.

Questions: do you offer blended per-token pricing across embeddings/chat or is that model-differentiated? Any standard multipliers for "embed-heavy" workloads? Also curious about minimum commit bands and whether you support a short-term bridge (3 months) before committing to an annual tier.

Can you share an initial rate card and any recommendations for optimizing costs specific to embedding-heavy flows?

Thanks,
Kate
Kate Daniels
Head of Platform, SignalPath
https://signalpath.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kate Daniels <kate@signalpath.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SignalPath evaluation — need pricing for heavy-embed use

Hi Kate — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. High-level answers first, then I attached a simple spreadsheet with three proposal options.

Short answers:
- We generally price per-token with model-specific rates. Embeddings are usually a lower SKU multiplier vs chat, but that depends on the model family (standard vs premium).
- We can provide a short-term commit bridge (3 months) that converts into an annual commit with pro-rated credits if you hit the annual target.
- For embed-heavy workloads we often recommend batching + streaming offload patterns and using the standard embedding family with 0.6x multiplier vs the premium chat SKU.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-blend-20270310.xlsx (three scenarios: Ramp (3mo bridge) / Mid-commit (6mo) / Annual commit with blended rate).

Option highlights (numbers are illustrative — see sheet):
- 3mo Bridge: no long-term lock, 15% discount on standard model per-token, embeddings multiplier 0.65x. Credits applied toward first annual commit if converted within 90 days.
- 6mo Mid: 25% discount on usage up to committed band, embeddings multiplier 0.6x, access to one dedicated pre-sell pricing review.
- Annual Commit: deeper tiers (40%+ depending on volume), ability to pin premium models for chat at a fixed multiplier (1.6x).

Would you like us to model a blended per-token rate (single number) for budgeting, or present per-SKU rates plus an expected blended spend given your projected model mix?

I'll loop Vanessa to confirm the embedding technical considerations that affect unit costs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kate Daniels <kate@signalpath.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SignalPath evaluation — need pricing for heavy-embed use

Kate — quick technical note to help budget modeling. Two things to consider that change the effective per-token cost:

1) Embedding families: our standard embedding model (redwood-embed-1) is optimized for batched requests and uses a lower compute kernel; it's typically ~0.55–0.7x of the redwood-chat-1 standard token rate depending on sequence length. Long context (many vectors per request) benefits a per-call batching credit we can apply.

2) Premium chat models (redwood-chat-pro) have higher per-token execution cost but sometimes reduce overall tokens by better summarization (fewer round trips). If you can move more retrieval/embedding work to the standard family and reserve premium chat for final responses, your blended spend is lower.

I'll add a small worksheet that applies your projected token mix (you mentioned 75% embed). If you send us a sample week of query volume (or your CSV), we can produce a blended per-token number.

-Vanessa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Kate Daniels <kate@signalpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: commercial@signalpath.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 13:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SignalPath evaluation — need pricing for heavy-embed use

Thanks Marissa/Vanessa — appreciate the options and the doc. Quick counterpoints from procurement: 

- Ideally SignalPath wants a single blended per-token rate for budgeting (we can't show two SKUs in our forecasts). We're open to the blend being revisited after 6 months.
- For embeddings we need the multiplier to be <= 0.6x of chat standard to meet our internal cost targets.
- We would prefer a 3-month bridge that auto-converts to a 12-month commit if we hit 3x the bridge volume. If conversion doesn't happen we'll pay an overage rather than an early termination penalty.

Is there flexibility on the embed multiplier and conversion mechanics? We can share a short CSV with sample weekly traffic (attached).

Kate

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Kate Daniels <kate@signalpath.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SignalPath evaluation — need pricing for heavy-embed use

Looping in for pricing approval. Hi Kate — good to meet you over email. We can do a customer-first pilot concession with the following constraints:

- 3-month bridge -> if SignalPath reaches >= 3x bridge volume within the bridge window, we convert to a 12-month committed band with a 30% discount off list for blended usage.
- For the pilot only, we will cap the embedding multiplier at 0.6x for the first 6 months. After month 6 we’ll re-evaluate blended usage and may normalize toward the standard multiplier.
- No early termination penalty for failing to convert; you’ll simply pay month-to-month overage at the bridge rate.
- We’ll include $10k in onboarding/credits to offset engineering integration/testing.

Marissa — please update the SOW with those terms and route to legal for a streamlined review (we can use DocuSign link in the sheet). Kate — if that looks acceptable I’ll authorize the discount and onboarding credit.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
